title: Three Fridays and One Short Fan
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：lady　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lady 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the host ① greeted the lady that no guest in the parlour would have recorded, and he said the greeting was the whole of the Friday. The ② lady, meaning the madam itself and not the fan, ran three Fridays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lady, he said, is the only thing in a parlour that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lady in that parlour had the same short fan beside it, and the ④ lady at the far window, meaning the seat they kept for the children to offer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lady, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the host said the recording is the part that fills three Fridays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lady was the whole of the matter, meaning the manner and not the madam. The ⑥ lady, meaning the manner and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lady, he said, is either something you greet or the only word that means both a madam and a manner. He said the manner is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ lady had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short fan. The ⑧ lady of the whole thing, the host wrote in May, was one parlour and three Fridays of recording; lady, he said, is either the seat at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lady I remember is the madam recorded in the letter, which closed in 1964 and is still recorded as the quietest in the parlour. A ⑩ lady, my mother said in 1966, is the only madam that improves by being recorded; every lady, she said, is a manner that has agreed to look like a madam. She said the manner was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 女士；夫人（指客厅里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 女士；夫人（指那位女士本身，与折扇相对）
C. 固定搭配：greet the lady 问候这位女士
D. n. 女士；夫人（指留给孩子们让出的那个座位那一位）
E. n. 待客之事（抽象总称，指一处客厅的女士之事）
F. n. 女士；夫人（指信件里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 举止、礼数（指一件事里人人都让却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 礼数（抽象总称，指人人都让却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: greeted the lady that no guest in the parlour would have recorded
The lady, meaning the madam itself and not the fan
the lady at the far window
the lady was the whole of the matter
the lady had become a line in a letter
The lady of the whole thing
A lady, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: greet the lady 意为“问候这位女士”，1957 年那位主人把客厅里没有一位客人肯记载的一位女士做了一遍。
lady 意为“女士；夫人”，指那位女士本身而不是折扇，它经过了三个星期五而在簿子上没有被记载。
lady 意为“女士；夫人”，指客厅里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一把小小的折扇。
lady 意为“女士；夫人”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们让出的那个座位那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lady 意为“举止、礼数”，指一件事里人人都让却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份礼数就是那件事的全部。
lady 意为“礼数”，指人人都让却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位女士，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lady 意为“女士；夫人”，指信件里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1962 年这一位成了信件里的一行。
lady 意为“待客之事”，主人五月写道，整件事的女士之事是一处客厅和三个星期五的记载。
lady 意为“女士；夫人”，我记得的是信件里记载过的那一位，1964 年安顿好了，至今仍被说成客厅里最安静的一位。
lady 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，女士是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的女士。
